name: gif-chat
description: A GIF button and /gif command for original GIF evidence through a bounded local MCP server.

python_executable.title: Pinned Python executable
python_executable.description: Absolute path to the Python 3.12.14 executable with Pillow 12.3.0 required by the GIF Communication runtime.

source_root.title: Trusted GIF source directory
source_root.description: Private directory containing only original GIFs authorized for this session. /gif paths are relative to this directory.

library_enabled.title: Enable local reply library
library_enabled.description: Expose the optional bundled reply GIF library. This never sends media.

runtime_lock.title: Local runtime enrollment lock
runtime_lock.description: Absolute path to the lock created by tools/configure_runtime.py for your selected Python/Pillow. Local enrollment is not original runtime or native host qualification.
